article.title: Why the Optimal Targeting Threshold Changes When Capacity Changes
article.why: Connect expected incremental value, action cost, ranking, and capacity constraints in targeting decisions.
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

sources.label: Background: decision theory and constrained optimization

paragraphs.en:
A predictive model often produces a ranking: customer A has a higher score than customer B, who has a higher score than customer C. That ranking is useful, but a business ultimately needs a policy: whom should we contact, approve, inspect, or serve? Turning scores into actions requires a threshold, and the economically sensible threshold depends not only on model quality but also on expected incremental benefit, action cost, and operational capacity.

Start with the simplest case. Suppose contacting a customer costs 100 yen and a successful incremental conversion produces 2,000 yen of contribution margin. If the model estimates the incremental probability of conversion caused by contact, the expected incremental value is 2,000 times that probability minus 100. A customer with a 10% incremental probability has expected value of 100 yen; a customer with 2% has expected value of minus 60 yen. If capacity is unlimited, a natural policy is to contact customers whose expected incremental value is positive. The economic threshold is where expected benefit equals cost.

Now introduce a capacity constraint. Perhaps the call center can contact only 20,000 customers even though 60,000 customers have positive expected value. The business cannot execute every profitable action. In that case, it should generally prioritize the highest expected incremental values among the positive-value population until capacity is exhausted. The effective selection cutoff rises because scarce capacity has an opportunity cost: using one slot for a lower-value customer prevents using that slot for a higher-value customer.

The reverse case is equally important. Suppose capacity expands from 20,000 to 80,000 contacts, but only 60,000 customers have positive expected value. A common operational instinct is to ‘fill capacity’ and contact 80,000 people. Economically, that is not automatically rational. The extra 20,000 may have negative expected value. Capacity is an upper bound, not a requirement to act. More available resources should lower the cutoff only until the marginal action reaches zero expected net value, unless there is another strategic reason to accept a short-term loss.

This shows why a fixed Top-N rule can be misleading. ‘Always contact the top 10%’ ignores changes in campaign economics, treatment cost, margin, customer population, and capacity. If contact cost doubles, the value threshold should change even when model scores do not. If contribution margin rises, more customers may become economically attractive. If the eligible population doubles while capacity stays fixed, the selected percentage may fall even though the number contacted remains constant. A stable percentile is not necessarily a stable policy.

Another complication is that ordinary propensity scores or purchase probabilities are not the same as incremental value. A customer who is very likely to buy without intervention may rank highly on purchase probability but generate little incremental benefit from contact. For targeting, uplift or treatment-effect estimates can be more aligned with the decision when credible causal identification is available. Even then, estimates should be combined with costs and values rather than treated as a complete policy by themselves.

Uncertainty also matters near the threshold. Two customers may have estimated net values of 105 and 100 yen, but those estimates may be noisy. A rigid ordering can create false precision. Businesses may use broader priority bands, exploration samples, or conservative thresholds when estimation uncertainty is large. In regulated or fairness-sensitive contexts, additional constraints may also override a purely monetary ranking. The optimization objective must represent the real decision, not merely the easiest number to calculate.

Capacity can itself have a shadow price. When every available contact slot is used and many positive-value customers remain, an additional slot has economic value approximately related to the marginal opportunity that could be served. This helps answer a management question that a ranking alone cannot: is it worth buying more capacity? If the marginal expected value of another action exceeds the marginal capacity cost, expansion may be justified. If not, a larger operation may simply add expense.

The practical lesson is to separate three layers. Prediction estimates what may happen. Economic valuation translates outcomes into benefits and costs. Policy optimization decides which actions to take under constraints. A model ranking belongs mainly to the first layer; it does not automatically solve the third. When capacity changes, the optimal cutoff can move even if the model is unchanged. Good targeting therefore asks not only ‘Who ranks highest?’ but ‘Which actions create positive incremental value, and which of those should receive scarce capacity?’
paragraphs.zh:
預測模型通常先產生 ranking：A 的分數高於 B，B 又高於 C。Ranking 很有用，但企業最後需要的是 policy：到底要聯絡、核准、檢查或服務哪些人？把 score 轉成 action 需要 threshold，而合理的經濟門檻不只取決於模型品質，也取決於預期增量收益、行動成本與營運容量。

先看最簡單情況。假設聯絡一名顧客成本100日圓，而因聯絡新增的一次成功轉換能帶來2,000日圓 contribution margin。如果模型估的是「因聯絡而增加的轉換機率」，expected incremental value 就是 2,000×該機率−100。增量機率10%的顧客預期淨值為100日圓；2%的顧客則是−60日圓。若容量無限，自然的 policy 是只聯絡 expected incremental value 為正的人，經濟 threshold 就在預期收益等於成本的位置。

接著加入 capacity constraint。假設 call center 最多只能聯絡20,000人，但有60,000人的預期淨值為正。企業無法執行所有有利可圖的 action，因此通常應在正價值人群中依 expected incremental value 由高到低選，直到容量用完。此時有效 cutoff 會提高，因為稀缺 capacity 有 opportunity cost：把一個名額給低價值顧客，就失去把它給更高價值顧客的機會。

反過來也很重要。若 capacity 從20,000擴到80,000，但只有60,000名顧客具有正 expected value，營運上常會想「把容量塞滿」而聯絡80,000人。但額外20,000人可能是負價值。Capacity 是上限，不是一定要執行的配額。資源增加可以降低 cutoff，但只應降到 marginal action 的 expected net value 為0，除非另有策略理由願意承擔短期損失。

這說明固定 Top-N 規則可能誤導。「永遠聯絡 top 10%」忽略 campaign economics、treatment cost、margin、customer population 與 capacity 的變化。若聯絡成本翻倍，即使模型分數不變，價值 threshold 也應改變；margin 上升時，更多顧客可能變得值得聯絡；eligible population 翻倍但 capacity 不變時，被選比例可能下降，即使實際聯絡人數沒變。固定 percentile 並不等於固定 policy。

另一個問題是，一般 propensity score 或 purchase probability 不等於 incremental value。某顧客即使不聯絡也很可能購買，因此 purchase probability 很高，卻未必因聯絡產生多少增量收益。若 causal identification 可信，uplift 或 treatment-effect estimate 對 targeting 更貼近決策；但即使如此，也必須再結合成本與價值，不能把估計值本身當成完整 policy。

Threshold 附近的 uncertainty 也很重要。兩位顧客估計淨值可能是105與100日圓，但估計本身有噪音，僵硬排序會製造虛假的精確感。企業可以採用較寬的 priority band、exploration sample，或在不確定性高時使用較保守門檻。在監管或 fairness 敏感的情境，也可能有額外限制凌駕純金錢 ranking。Optimization objective 必須代表真正的決策，而不是最容易計算的數字。

Capacity 本身也可以有 shadow price。當所有聯絡名額都已用完、仍有大量正價值顧客未被服務時，增加一個名額具有接近 marginal opportunity 的經濟價值。這能回答 ranking 本身回答不了的管理問題：值得購買更多 capacity 嗎？若新增 action 的 marginal expected value 高於新增 capacity cost，擴充可能合理；反之，擴大營運只會增加成本。

實務上應分成三層：Prediction 估計可能發生什麼；economic valuation 把結果轉成收益與成本；policy optimization 在限制下決定採取哪些 action。模型 ranking 主要屬於第一層，不能自動解決第三層。Capacity 改變時，即使模型完全不變，最佳 cutoff 也可能移動。好的 targeting 不只問「誰排名最高」，還要問「哪些 action 具有正的 incremental value，以及這些 action 中誰應取得稀缺 capacity」。
paragraphs.ja:
予測モデルは通常rankingを出します。AのscoreがBより高く、BがCより高い、といった順序です。しかし企業が最終的に必要なのはpolicy、つまり誰に連絡・承認・検査・サービスを行うかです。scoreをactionへ変えるにはthresholdが必要で、その経済的に妥当な水準はモデル精度だけでなく、期待増分便益、action cost、運用capacityにも依存します。

最も単純なケースから考えます。顧客への連絡コストが100円、連絡によって増えた成約1件のcontribution marginが2,000円だとします。モデルが連絡による増分成約確率を推定しているなら、expected incremental valueは2,000×増分確率−100です。増分確率10%なら期待純価値は100円、2%なら−60円です。capacityが無制限なら、期待増分価値が正の顧客へ連絡するのが自然で、経済thresholdは期待便益とコストが等しくなる点です。

次にcapacity constraintを入れます。call centerが20,000人にしか連絡できないのに、正の期待価値を持つ顧客が60,000人いる場合、全ての有益なactionは実行できません。通常は正価値層の中でexpected incremental valueが高い順にcapacityまで選びます。希少なcapacityにはopportunity costがあり、低価値顧客に1枠使うと高価値顧客へ使う機会を失うため、実効的なcutoffは上がります。

逆も重要です。capacityが20,000から80,000へ増えても、正のexpected valueを持つ顧客が60,000人しかいないなら、「枠を埋めるため」80,000人へ連絡することが合理的とは限りません。追加20,000人は負の期待価値かもしれません。capacityは上限であって、必ず使い切るquotaではありません。追加資源でcutoffを下げるとしても、原則としてmarginal actionの期待純価値が0になるところまでです。

だから固定Top-Nルールは危険です。「常にtop 10%へ連絡」はcampaign economics、treatment cost、margin、母集団、capacityの変化を無視します。連絡コストが倍になればscoreが同じでもvalue thresholdは変わります。marginが上がれば対象は広がり得ます。eligible populationが倍になりcapacityが一定なら、連絡人数が同じでも選択率は下がります。固定percentileは固定policyではありません。

さらに通常のpropensity scoreやpurchase probabilityはincremental valueと同じではありません。介入しなくても買う顧客はpurchase probabilityが高くても、連絡による増分便益は小さい可能性があります。信頼できるcausal identificationがあるならupliftやtreatment-effect estimateのほうがtargetingに整合しますが、それでもcostとvalueを組み合わせて初めてpolicyになります。

threshold付近のuncertaintyにも注意が必要です。期待純価値105円と100円という差が推定ノイズの範囲なら、厳密な順位は偽の精密さを生みます。priority band、exploration sample、保守的thresholdなどを使う余地があります。規制やfairnessが重要な領域では、金銭価値以外の制約がrankingを上書きすることもあります。optimization objectiveは計算しやすい数字ではなく、実際の意思決定を表す必要があります。

capacityにはshadow priceもあります。全枠を使い切っても正価値顧客が残るなら、追加1枠にはmarginal opportunityに対応する経済価値があります。これにより「capacityを追加購入すべきか」というrankingだけでは答えられない経営判断ができます。追加actionのmarginal expected valueが追加capacity costを上回れば拡張が合理的になり得ます。

実務では三層を分けます。Predictionは何が起こりそうかを推定し、economic valuationは結果を便益とコストへ変換し、policy optimizationは制約下でどのactionを取るか決めます。モデルrankingは主に第一層であり、第三層を自動的には解きません。capacityが変わればモデルが同じでも最適cutoffは動きます。良いtargetingは「誰の順位が高いか」だけでなく、「どのactionが正のincremental valueを生み、その中で誰に希少capacityを配るべきか」を問います。

vocabulary.usage: Target customers with positive incremental value.
A capacity constraint can raise the cutoff.
Scarce capacity has an opportunity cost.
Compare marginal value with marginal cost.
The optimal cutoff changes with capacity.
Uplift can align targeting with incremental effects.
Capacity can have a shadow price.
Keep an exploration sample near uncertain thresholds.

phrases.term: capacity is an upper bound, not a quota
phrases.explanation: 容量可用不代表必須塞滿。
phrases.example: Remember that capacity is an upper bound, not a quota.

grammar.title: even if
grammar.body: 表示即使條件不變，結果仍可能因其他因素改變，例如 the cutoff can move even if the model is unchanged.

business.term: Let’s optimize for incremental value, not rank alone.
business.example: Let’s optimize for incremental value, not rank alone.

business.term: What is the marginal value of one more slot?
business.explanation: 用於 capacity expansion 判斷。
business.example: Before adding agents, ask: what is the marginal value of one more slot?

quiz.question: Why should capacity expansion not automatically mean contacting more customers?
quiz.answer: Additional customers may have negative expected net value; capacity is a maximum, not an obligation to act.
